g.text: THE MATRIX TODAY — ENTITY RELATIONSHIP DIAGRAM
Simplified PostgreSQL ERD | Up to 3 selected attributes per entity | 9 enforced relationships
Underlined attribute = declared primary key | FK = enforced foreign key | 0..M = zero or many
Numbers beside an entity state how many of that entity can relate to one entity at the opposite end.
Selected attributes only. daily_visits has 2 columns; other entities show 3. Unconnected tables have no enforced FKs.
Metadata verified 2026-11-17. Unique indexes are not represented; verification_tokens has no declared primary key.
